t: A palm-sized programmable robot cat that walks, poses and answers voice commands.
steps: Buy the pre-assembled Nybble Q from Petoi or a maker store such as Maker Shed.
Charge the battery with a 5 V USB-C charger, which is sold separately.
Install the free Petoi app on your computer or phone.
Connect over Bluetooth and try a built-in skill such as walking.
Try a voice command and watch the cat respond.
Open Petoi Coding Blocks and build a short routine.
Move on to the Arduino IDE with the ESP32 Dev Module setting for more control.
meta: Open Code. From $304. Easy to find.
